answer: A trellis-bound mutual stake pool makes sybil farming expensive. Each identity joins a small trellis of peers and locks a refundable stake in a shared vault; the group's standing rises only when every member completes peer-checked work. A mesa jury audits groups at random, and if one member is exposed as a fake, the whole group's bond is slashed and its vault access frozen. Attackers must fund, staff and keep honest a full trellis per fake identity, turning cheap copies into costly, fragile conspiracies. Honest groups earn their stake back, so real agents gain while fakes bleed.
